description:
Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client

The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
Session management redesigned: the butler lists pending decisions, and the roster uses grouped cards with a detail drawer.
Agents generate robot characters from descriptions, and custom VRM models can be imported in Labs.
Character motion is more natural, with smoother arm, head, breathing, and upper-body movement.
Web pages open in independent windows and remain active when switching sessions.
A built-in video creation skill supports producing videos directly within workflows.
Performance improvements for a smoother experience.
Fixed several known issues.
source: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
